Results.ReviewText: I am very, very happy with my grill.  I have owned several grills in the past from other brands. I noticed that when I was putting it together.  It is easy to use, easy to clean, and most importantly, food just comes out perfect.  I must confess that cooking is not one of my strengths.  So, I use the little cooking guide that came with the grill.  It just tells you how long to cook different foods for and if you should use high, medium, direct, or indirect heat.  I have had my grill now for several weeks, and I have made a variety of foods - fish, beef, chicken, pork, hamburgers, vegetables, skewers.  Everything comes out really nice and juicy.  I could go on and on, but I'll tell you this,  I was a little apprehensive at first about buying this grill because it was more expensive than others I was considering.  IT IS HANDS DOWN WORTH IT.  Now I think that I should have bought a Weber grill years ago, and save all the hassle of dealing with other grills that couldn't do the job.  By the way, I am not getting anything from Weber for writing this review.  I am simply happy to have a high quality product that works extremely well, and wish to pass this on to others.

Results.ReviewText:
I bought my first Weber Kettle grill in 1985. There's a lot of imitators on the market but they've never compared in quality or in their ability to adapt to various methods of cooking. I've cooked pizza's, smoked chicken, pork butts, ribs and even prime rib along with the never ending list of fish, burgers, sausages, chops and of course steak. Controlling the temperature has never been a problem.

I've never bought a gas grill, though I have been given them as presents for Father's Day over the years. They'd usually last about two years before I'd have to start replacing parts. I'm not really sure how many I've taken to the curb on trash day but it was something that was repeated often. Always eyeing a Weber but receiving something else I'm thankful this year that has changed. I finally received a Weber gas grill to go along with my Weber Kettle and Smokey Mountain Smoker.... I couldn't be happier! Assembly was easy and didn't take very long. I'm not sure what I like best about the grill but the list is extensive. Some of the things I like (not in order) are the grates and how they give great sear marks, how easy it is to clean, that it comes up to temperature very quickly and at a glance (without lifting) I know how much gas is in the cylinder. The grill heats up amazingly fast and holds it's temperature very well! The quality of the components is top notch and let's not forget how well finished it is! I am extremely pleased with this grill and just like all my other Weber grills, I know it will last a long long time.
Results.Title: My Weber Experience

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
